note: T156 step-free travel: access-needs card lines that src/content/helpcards.json does not already have (wheelchair, step-free and 'I need to sit down' are reused from there). Same languages as helpcards.json. Written by the model (not a native speaker): every line is marked "check": true until a native speaker has read it. Simple, polite, gender-neutral wording; pt reads in both Portugal and Brazil; zh-Hant uses Taiwan wording. T157: the liftAsk line also opens as a full-screen phrase card ('Where is the lift?'); non-Latin languages carry a 'roman' guide in the phrases.json style (Hepburn, Hanyu Pinyin, Revised Romanization, simple RTGS), also written by the model and covered by the same check flag.

sentences.en: I have a pram (stroller). Is there a way with no steps?
I can only walk a short distance.

pram.text: ベビーカーを使っています。段差のない道はありますか？

walkLimited.text: 長い距離は歩けません。

liftAsk.text: エレベーターはどこですか？

pram.text: 我推着婴儿车。有没有没有台阶的路？
我推著嬰兒車。有沒有不用走樓梯的路？
유모차를 가지고 있어요. 계단 없는 길이 있나요?

walkLimited.text: 저는 짧은 거리만 걸을 수 있어요.

pram.text: ฉันมีรถเข็นเด็ก มีทางที่ไม่มีขั้นบันไดไหม

walkLimited.text: ฉันเดินได้แค่ระยะสั้นๆ

liftAsk.text: ลิฟต์อยู่ที่ไหน

pram.text: Tôi có xe đẩy em bé. Có lối đi không có bậc thang không?

walkLimited.text: Tôi chỉ đi bộ được một quãng ngắn.

pram.text: Llevo un cochecito de bebé. ¿Hay un camino sin escalones?
J'ai une poussette. Y a-t-il un passage sans marches ?

walkLimited.text: Je ne peux marcher que sur de courtes distances.

pram.text: Ich habe einen Kinderwagen. Gibt es einen Weg ohne Stufen?

walkLimited.text: Ich kann nur kurze Strecken gehen.

pram.text: Ho un passeggino. C'è un percorso senza gradini?

walkLimited.text: Posso camminare solo per brevi distanze.

pram.text: Tenho um carrinho para criança. Há um caminho sem degraus?
Saya membawa kereta bayi. Apakah ada jalan tanpa tangga?

walkLimited.text: Saya hanya bisa berjalan jarak pendek.
